title: Scarves or hats only.
text: Scarves or hats only.. This is a very light duty hook hanger. It's best used with things like scarves or hats. Leashes are a bit too heavy - it definitely won't hold handbags. Mine was missing the screws the box said were included. It still holds over the top of the door, but even with screws it would still be weak.
